To be considered for this competition you must be enrolled in a registered co-op program at a Canadian post-secondary institution, and eligible for a Work Term during the specified period.  Students must upload proof of enrolment in a co-op program when completing your application. 

Job Summary

This job is exclusively for Coop Students who are enrolled in a recognized post-secondary co-operative education program.

The mandate of Information Technology Services is to create business value by providing innovative and strategic technology solutions for the business operations of the City of Ottawa.

This role is focused on developing enterprise-grade data pipelines and engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering Standards, Accelerators, and the Operating Model. You will design and build ETL data pipelines to enable the creation of trusted data assets, perform data transformations, and optimize data workflows for scalability and efficiency.

Additionally, you will collaborate closely with clients and stakeholders to ensure that the right data is delivered in the right format to support advanced use cases, including reporting, analytics, and AI/ML initiatives.

Education And Experience

Enrolment in a recognized post-secondary co-operative program in computer science, computer engineering, information technology or related field

No Experience Required

KNOWLEDGE



- Computer science concepts, methodologies and practices
- Project management principles
- Knowledge of applicable health and safety legislation, including the rights and duties of workers



Competencies, Skills And Abilities



- Critical thinking, problem-solving and analytical skills
- Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing
- Good interpersonal skills
- Work effectively as a team member and independently
- Good work ethic
- Organized and dependable
- Positive attitude
- Self-motivated
- Client service oriented
- Enjoy working in a dynamic environment



What You Need To Know



- Language Requirement: English oral, reading, writing 
- Experience and formal training combined with demonstrated performance and ability may substitute for stipulated academic requirements. 
- Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

About 1FINITY

1Finity, a Fujitsu company, is a global provider of communications networks for our connected world. We uniquely combine technological leadership and expertise in open optical and wireless networking, network automation, and applied AI/ML to design, build, operate, and maintain critical digital communications network infrastructure. Collaborating closely with ecosystem partners, we deliver transformative outcomes for service providers and network operators, and enable them to lower TCO, improve network performance, and increase energy efficiency. We’re also a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace that achieves together. We offer highly competitive compensation, benefits, and career development opportunities, as well as flexible options for working your way. See what working at 1Finity looks like at https://www.linkedin.com/company/1finity-inc/. For more information, please visit https://1finity.com/?utm_source=li&utm_medium=soc.

Job Title: Software Development Intern

Location: Richardson, TX

Are you a curious and motivated student looking to gain hands-on experience in the world of optical networking and embedded software development? 1Finity America Inc. is seeking interns pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields to join our Software Development team in Richardson, TX.

As an intern, you’ll work alongside experienced engineers on real-world projects that contribute to the development of next-generation optical transport systems. You’ll gain exposure to modern software practices, embedded Linux development, and collaborative engineering workflows.

🔧 Internship Responsibilities



- Assist in the design, development, and testing of software components for optical networking platforms. 
- Participate in code reviews, team discussions, and agile development ceremonies. 
- Support debugging and troubleshooting efforts across software and hardware interfaces. 
- Contribute to documentation and automation tasks to improve development workflows. 
- Learn and apply best practices in embedded systems and network software development. 

✅ Preferred Qualifications



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in CS, CE, EE, or a related discipline. 
- Familiarity with C/C++ programming, especially in systems or embedded contexts. 
- Experience working with or learning Linux-based development environments. 
- Exposure to version control systems like Git and basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines. 
- Interest in networking technologies and embedded systems. 
- Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Go, or Rust is a plus. 
- Strong communication skills and a willingness to learn in a collaborative team environment. 

🌟 Bonus Experience (Not Required)



- Academic projects or coursework related to networking, embedded systems, or telecommunications. 
- Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, Docker, or Kubernetes. 
- Interest in areas such as network telemetry, AI/ML for network optimization, or open source contributions. 

🚀 Why Intern with Us?

At 1Finity America Inc., you’ll be part of a team that’s pushing the boundaries of optical networking. You’ll gain valuable experience working on impactful projects, receive mentorship from industry experts, and explore career paths in embedded software and telecom innovation.

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this position is: $25/hr. to $35/hr.

Placement in the range depends on several factors such as experience and skills and may change over time.

We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws.

Applications are being accepted on an ongoing basis.
